topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I stood there, the news hanging between me and the crisp evening air, a curtain drawn over a familiar comfort. The restaurant, a sanctuary of scents and whispers, where time seemed to dissolve into the gentle sizzle of the kitchen and the murmur of old friends, was no more. It's closing, they said. A part of me, the part that craved the unchanged landmarks of my world, ached. Yet, in the hollow space left behind, there was a spark. A place for new stories to unfold, uncharted and promising. The thought of it, the possibility, lifted the weight just a touch. Perhaps endings are merely the beginnings we haven't met yet.
